import html # Example template – replace with the actual one if different. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{post_heading}

by {user_name}

{post_content}
{post_tags}
""" def build_post_html(user_name: str, post_heading: str, post_content: str, post_tags: list[str]) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- user_name : str The author of the post. post_heading : str The title of the post. post_content : str The main body of the post. post_tags : list[str] A list of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str The HTML string ready for safe rendering. """ # Escape all user-provided content to avoid injection esc_user_name = html.escape(user_name, quote=True) esc_heading = html.escape(post_heading, quote=True) esc_content = html.escape(post_content, quote=False) # Sanitize tags and wrap each in a escaped_tags = [ f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in post_tags ] tags_html = ' '.join(escaped_tags) # Format the final HTML return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( user_name=esc_user_name, post_heading=esc_heading, post_content=esc_content, post_tags=tags_html )
